name: ridestore-skills
description: Agent workflow plugins for Claude Code, Codex and OpenCode, usable in any GitHub repository.

plugins.name: pr-shepherd
plugins.description: Deliver a coding task as a normal pull request that passed a local multi-agent review before the first push: implement and validate in an isolated tree, run independent read-only reviewer agents on pinned models, fix every confirmed finding, open the PR, then follow up on review threads and CI.
